name: After § 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 10a. Stresses the lack of clear definitions of developed and developing countries (i.e. ‘less developed countries’) and the dichotomy of Annex I/non-Annex I countries; emphasises that, as NDCs are the main instrument for achieving the Paris Agreement’s long-term goals, the definitions and the inconsistencies between responsibilities and capabilities need to be clarified;
